title: AI News Roundup: Samay Raina's Viral Rumors, Creator Accolades, and Key Social Updates
summary: This week's AI news report highlights a blend of online culture, social issues, and entertainment. Content creator Samay Raina is at the center of widespread dating rumors, intensified by recent "Latent" episode promos featuring both Medha Shankar and Sharan Verma. Environmental activist Bittu Tabahi has garnered international recognition for his solo river clean-up efforts, praised by figures like Kevin Pietersen. Other notable stories include the announcement of a documentary for the late YouTuber Technoblade, director Vishal Chaturvedi's critique of Bollywood, and a tragic incident involving a 3-month-old girl in Uttar Pradesh.
article:
**Samay Raina's Personal Life Dominates Online Discourse Amidst "Latent" Episode Releases**

Online communities are currently captivated by speculation surrounding content creator Samay Raina's romantic relationships. Initially linked to actress Medha Shankar, recent "Latent" episodes featuring Sharan Verma shifted fan attention, leading to widespread "shipping" of Raina and Verma. The intrigue deepened with a recent promo for an upcoming "Latent" episode, surprisingly featuring both rumored partners. This unexpected pairing has fueled numerous fan theories, with some humorously suggesting Raina orchestrated a strategic "999 IQ move." Beyond the romantic speculation, Raina continues to expand his "Latent" series, announcing upcoming episodes with Bollywood star Varun Dhawan on Netflix, and Rakhi Sawant on both Netflix and YouTube.

**Archana Puran Singh's Family Responds to Samay Raina's Playful Roasts**

Archana Puran Singh's family recently addressed Samay Raina's light-hearted roasts during her "Latent" episode. Raina had playfully commented on her family's vlog-centric lifestyle. Her son, Arya Man Sethi, a vlogger, along with his family, responded in a video, clarifying the comments were understood as jokes and emphasizing their positive relationship with Raina. Sethi also advocated for a less sensitive approach to comedy.

**YouTuber Nitish Rajput Reportedly Set for Bigg Boss 20 Debut**

Popular YouTuber Nitish Rajput is rumored to be joining the upcoming season of "Bigg Boss 20." A report by Money Control indicated Rajput's potential participation, which, if confirmed, would mark his debut on mainstream television.

**Rajat Dalal Criticizes Media's Focus on Parking Incident**

Content creator Rajat Dalal expressed frustration with media coverage following a viral video of him forcefully moving a car that had blocked his vehicle. On Instagram, Dalal shared instances of similar illegal parking issues faced by himself and others in the Delhi-NCR region, challenging news outlets for singling out his incident when such dilemmas are widespread.

**Indian Environmental Activist Bittu Tabahi Garners International Recognition**

Indian environmental activist Bittu Tabahi is receiving widespread acclaim for his extraordinary river clean-up efforts. A viral clip, showcasing his solo transformation of a heavily polluted river, first gained mainstream attention after being shared by actress Sonakshi Sinha. His work then reached an international audience when English cricketer Kevin Pietersen praised him on Instagram. Pietersen detailed how the 20-year-old single-handedly cleaned a river without protective gear or swimming skills, after raising local funds, hailing his actions as "heroic" and deserving of global recognition.

**Shubman Gill Playfully Trolls Virat Kohli**

Cricketer Shubman Gill engaged in playful banter with Virat Kohli following a humorous video related to Virat and Anushka Sharma's son, Akai. Gill commented, tagging Kohli, with the reassuring message, "Bhai don't worry I got you," highlighting camaraderie.

**"Hanuman Ansh" Part Two Announced; Director Slams Bollywood's Initial Disinterest**

The creators of the successful film "Hanuman Ansh" have announced a sequel, with director Vishal Chaturvedi criticizing the Bollywood industry for its initial lack of support. Chaturvedi stated that despite seeking help, he received little assistance, yet was inundated with congratulatory messages post-success, singling out Madhur Bhandarkar as the only "genuine" well-wisher. "Hanuman Ansh Part 2" will continue the spiritual journey of Neem Karoli Baba, with a trilogy planned since before the first film's success.

**Sonu Sood's Nepal Flood Relief Sparks "Marketing" Accusation**

Actor Sonu Sood's ongoing humanitarian work in flood-affected Nepal has drawn both praise and controversy. A journalist on Twitter accused Sood of "marketing" his efforts. Sood responded gracefully, inviting the journalist to join him in Nepal to collaborate on relief efforts.

**Tragic Incident: 3-Month-Old Girl Raped in Uttar Pradesh**

A horrifying incident has been reported from Uttar Pradesh, where a 3-month-old girl was allegedly raped by a 35-year-old neighbor. The accused, a family friend, reportedly took the infant outside. Upon his return, the baby was found crying uncontrollably and bleeding. She was rushed to a district hospital, where doctors confirmed her critical condition. An FIR has been registered, and the police have arrested the accused.

**Unusual Car Storage in Bihar Goes Viral (Unverified)**

A bizarre incident from Bihar has gained traction on social media, depicting a man using a crane to place his Scorpio car on his house's roof. The purported reason is the owner's fear of car theft while his family is away. While viral, its authenticity remains unverified.

**Bengaluru Car's Abusive LED Sign Triggers Public Debate**

A car owner in Bengaluru has ignited a public debate after a video showed his vehicle displaying an abusive phrase on an LED screen. A concerned citizen tagged Bengaluru Police, questioning the public display of offensive language. Some supported intervention, while others defended the owner as a response to persistent honkers.

**Ghost Rumor Causes Mass Exodus from Maharashtra Hostel**

A ghost rumor at a Maharashtra hostel led to widespread panic, causing over 600 students to flee home. The incident began with rumors of a girl student becoming "possessed." A health assessment revealed no supernatural activity, attributing her symptoms to mental stress. Senior officials spent a night on campus, urging students to overcome superstitions.

**Karnataka Government School Roof Collapse Injures Students**

A distressing incident occurred at a government school in Karnataka where a classroom roof suddenly collapsed, injuring five to six students from classes five and six. Local authorities visited the school. The injured students received first aid at a district hospital and are reportedly not in serious condition. An inquiry has been launched.

**Creator Turns Tables, Scams a Scammer**

In a unique turn of events, a creator has reportedly managed to scam a scammer, effectively recovering money illicitly acquired by the scammer.

**Chinese Man Finds Niche in "Itch Scratching Services," Earning Significant Income**

A Chinese entrepreneur has established a unique and profitable business offering "itch scratching services," reportedly earning over ₹1 lakh monthly. The service uses massage-style beds and specially designed pointed nails for relaxation, attracting high demand due to urban stress levels, primarily from male clients.

**Indigo Plane Collides with Airport Pole in Srinagar**

An Indigo aircraft was involved in an unusual incident at Srinagar airport, colliding with an airport pole. All passengers and crew were safely evacuated without injuries. An inquiry has been initiated to determine the exact cause.

**Documentary Announced for Late YouTube Star Technoblade**

The legacy of the late popular YouTuber Technoblade, who garnered over 22 million subscribers, is set to be honored with an independent feature documentary. Riot Games and Hypixel Studios are collaborating with Technoblade's family to bring his story to the screen, with plans for a major festival premiere.
